checks.name: chk_audit_logs_actor
checks.expression: (((actor_kind='MEMBER') and (actor_member_id is not null)) or ((actor_kind='SYSTEM') and (actor_member_id is null)))

checks.name: chk_background_jobs_failure
checks.expression: ((((state in ('FAILED','RETRY_WAIT')) and (last_failure_code is not null)) or ((state in ('QUEUED','SUCCEEDED','CANCELLED')) and (last_failure_code is null))) or (state='RUNNING'))

checks.name: chk_background_jobs_lease
checks.expression: (((((((((state='RUNNING') and (locked_at is not null)) and (heartbeat_at is not null)) and (locked_until is not null)) and (worker_id is not null)) and (lease_epoch>0)) and (locked_at<=heartbeat_at)) and (heartbeat_at<locked_until)) or (((((state<>'RUNNING') and (locked_at is null)) and (heartbeat_at is null)) and (locked_until is null)) and (worker_id is null)))

checks.name: chk_background_jobs_terminal
checks.expression: ((((state in ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) and (finished_at is not null)) and (finished_at>=created_at)) or ((state not in ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) and (finished_at is null)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_bytes_digest
checks.expression: (((byte_size is null) and (sha256 is null)) or ((((byte_size is not null) and (sha256 is not null)) and (byte_size>0)) and (byte_size<=reserved_bytes)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_dimensions
checks.expression: (((width is null) and (height is null)) or ((((width is not null) and (height is not null)) and (width>0)) and (height>0)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_failure
checks.expression: (((state in ('MISSING','FAILED')) and (failure_code is not null)) or ((state not in ('MISSING','FAILED')) and (failure_code is null)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_published_payload
checks.expression: ((state not in ('PUBLISHING','READY')) or (((((((byte_size is not null) and (sha256 is not null)) and (width is not null)) and (height is not null)) and (output_mime='image/webp')) and (producer_lease_epoch is not null)) and (producer_lease_epoch>0)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_ready
checks.expression: ((state<>'READY') or (((published_at is not null) and (cleaned_at is null)) and (published_at>=created_at)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_reservation
checks.expression: ((((kind='THUMBNAIL') and (reserved_bytes between 1 and 524288)) or ((kind='PREVIEW') and (reserved_bytes between 1 and 4194304))) or ((kind='VIDEO_POSTER') and (reserved_bytes between 1 and 1048576)))

checks.name: chk_derived_assets_times
checks.expression: (((published_at is null) or (published_at>=created_at)) and ((cleaned_at is null) or (cleaned_at>=created_at)))

checks.name: chk_invitations_revoker_requires_revoked_at
checks.expression: ((revoked_by_member_id is null) or (revoked_at is not null))

checks.name: chk_invitations_used_pair
checks.expression: (((used_at is null) and (used_by_member_id is null)) or ((used_at is not null) and (used_by_member_id is not null)))

checks.name: chk_media_items_capture
checks.expression: (((((((captured_time_status='ABSENT') and (captured_source='NONE')) and (captured_local_at is null)) and (captured_at_utc is null)) and (captured_offset_minutes is null)) or (((((captured_time_status='OFFSET_UNKNOWN') and (captured_source<>'NONE')) and (captured_local_at is not null)) and (captured_at_utc is null)) and (captured_offset_minutes is null))) or (((((((captured_time_status='OFFSET_KNOWN') and (captured_source<>'NONE')) and (captured_local_at is not null)) and (captured_at_utc is not null)) and (captured_offset_minutes is not null)) and (captured_offset_minutes between -840 and 840)) and ((abs(captured_offset_minutes)<840) or ((captured_offset_minutes%60)=0))))

checks.name: chk_media_items_description
checks.expression: ((description is null) or ((char_length(description) between 1 and 4000) and (length(description)<=16000)))

checks.name: chk_media_items_display_dimensions
checks.expression: (((display_width is null) and (display_height is null)) or ((((display_width is not null) and (display_height is not null)) and (display_width>0)) and (display_height>0)))

checks.name: chk_media_items_failure
checks.expression: (((processing_state in ('FAILED','BLOCKED')) and (last_failure_code is not null)) or ((processing_state not in ('FAILED','BLOCKED')) and ((processing_state='PARTIAL') or (last_failure_code is null))))

checks.name: chk_media_items_gps
checks.expression: (((gps_latitude is null) and (gps_longitude is null)) or ((((gps_latitude is not null) and (gps_longitude is not null)) and (gps_latitude between -90 and 90)) and (gps_longitude between -180 and 180)))

checks.name: chk_media_items_raw_dimensions
checks.expression: (((raw_width is null) and (raw_height is null)) or ((((raw_width is not null) and (raw_height is not null)) and (raw_width>0)) and (raw_height>0)))

checks.name: chk_media_items_timeline
checks.expression: ((((timeline_basis='CAPTURE_LOCAL') and (captured_local_at is not null)) and (timeline_key=captured_local_at)) or ((timeline_basis='UPLOAD_UTC') and (timeline_key=uploaded_at)))

checks.name: chk_media_items_trash_state
checks.expression: (((((trashed_at is null) and (trashed_by_member_id is null)) and (purge_after is null)) and (purge_intent_id is null)) or (((((trashed_at is not null) and (trashed_by_member_id is not null)) and (purge_after is not null)) and ((trashed_at+interval 30 day) is not null)) and (purge_after=(trashed_at+interval 30 day))))

checks.name: chk_location_city
checks.expression: ((city_geoname_id is null) or ((country_code is not null) and (city_geoname_id>0)))

checks.name: chk_purge_files_kind
checks.expression: ((((((((((file_kind='ORIGINAL') and (storage_object_id is not null)) and (content_sha256 is not null)) and (generation is null)) and (recipe_id is null)) and (derived_kind is null)) and (producer_job_id is null)) and (producer_epoch is null)) and (stage<>'ABSENT_DERIVED')) or (((((((((file_kind='DERIVED') and (media_id is not null)) and (generation is not null)) and (recipe_id is not null)) and (derived_kind is not null)) and (producer_job_id is not null)) and (producer_epoch is not null)) and (content_sha256 is not null)) and (storage_object_id is null)))

checks.name: chk_purge_files_original_singleton
checks.expression: ((((file_kind='ORIGINAL') and (original_singleton_slot is not null)) and (original_singleton_slot=1)) or ((file_kind='DERIVED') and (original_singleton_slot is null)))

checks.name: chk_purge_files_quarantine
checks.expression: (((((stage in ('CATALOGUED','ABSENT_DERIVED')) and (quarantine_slot is null)) and (quarantine_device is null)) and (quarantine_inode is null)) or ((((stage in ('QUARANTINED','UNLINK_ARMED','REMOVED')) and (quarantine_slot is not null)) and (quarantine_device is not null)) and (quarantine_inode is not null)))

checks.name: chk_purge_intents_lease
checks.expression: (((((((execution_state='RUNNING') and (worker_id is not null)) and (locked_at is not null)) and (heartbeat_at is not null)) and (locked_until is not null)) and (lease_epoch>=1)) or (((((execution_state<>'RUNNING') and (worker_id is null)) and (locked_at is null)) and (heartbeat_at is null)) and (locked_until is null)))

checks.name: chk_purge_intents_progress
checks.expression: ((((progress='COMPLETED') and (execution_state='DONE')) and (completed_at is not null)) or (((progress<>'COMPLETED') and (execution_state<>'DONE')) and (completed_at is null)))

checks.name: chk_purge_intents_retention
checks.expression: (((trashed_at+interval 30 day) is not null) and (purge_after=(trashed_at+interval 30 day)))

checks.name: chk_sessions_revoked_pair
checks.expression: (((revoked_at is null) and (revoke_reason is null)) or ((revoked_at is not null) and (revoke_reason is not null)))

checks.name: chk_share_events_actor
checks.expression: (((event_type in ('CREATE','REVOKE')) and (actor_member_id is not null)) or ((event_type='ACCESS') and (actor_member_id is null)))

checks.name: chk_shares_revoke_pair
checks.expression: (((revoked_at is null) and (revoked_by_member_id is null)) or ((revoked_at is not null) and (revoked_by_member_id is not null)))

checks.name: chk_upload_sessions_complete
checks.expression: (((((((((state='COMPLETE') and (storage_object_id is not null)) and (completed_at is not null)) and (terminal_at is null)) and (retired_storage_object_id is null)) and (retired_purge_id is null)) and (retired_at is null)) or (((((((state='RETIRED') and (storage_object_id is null)) and (completed_at is not null)) and (terminal_at is null)) and (retired_storage_object_id is not null)) and (retired_purge_id is not null)) and (retired_at is not null))) or ((((((state not in ('COMPLETE','RETIRED')) and (storage_object_id is null)) and (completed_at is null)) and (retired_storage_object_id is null)) and (retired_purge_id is null)) and (retired_at is null)))

checks.name: chk_upload_sessions_failure
checks.expression: (((state='FAILED') and (failure_code is not null)) or ((state<>'FAILED') and (failure_code is null)))

checks.name: chk_upload_sessions_finalize_pair
checks.expression: (((computed_sha256 is null) and (finalize_started_at is null)) or ((computed_sha256 is not null) and (finalize_started_at is not null)))

checks.name: chk_upload_sessions_finalize_state
checks.expression: ((((((state in ('FINALIZING','COMPLETE','RETIRED')) and (computed_sha256 is not null)) and (finalize_started_at is not null)) and (committed_offset=declared_size)) or (((state in ('CREATED','UPLOADING','ABORTED','EXPIRED')) and (computed_sha256 is null)) and (finalize_started_at is null))) or ((state='FAILED') and (((computed_sha256 is null) and (finalize_started_at is null)) or (((computed_sha256 is not null) and (finalize_started_at is not null)) and (committed_offset=declared_size)))))

checks.name: chk_upload_sessions_terminal
checks.expression: (((state in ('FAILED','ABORTED','EXPIRED')) and (terminal_at is not null)) or ((state not in ('FAILED','ABORTED','EXPIRED')) and (terminal_at is null)))

checks.name: chk_upload_sessions_times
checks.expression: ((((((((finalize_started_at is null) or (finalize_started_at>=created_at)) and ((completed_at is null) or (completed_at>=created_at))) and ((terminal_at is null) or (terminal_at>=created_at))) and ((staging_cleaned_at is null) or (staging_cleaned_at>=created_at))) and ((completed_at is null) or ((finalize_started_at is not null) and (completed_at>=finalize_started_at)))) and ((retired_at is null) or ((completed_at is not null) and (retired_at>=completed_at)))) and ((staging_cleaned_at is null) or (state in ('COMPLETE','RETIRED','FAILED','ABORTED','EXPIRED'))))
